usageNotes: Use this endpoint to update an existing SDN prefix list's entries or remove specific entries — for example, to add or prune CIDR prefixes used in BGP route filtering or firewall policy. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on the specific prefix-list path. Always supply the current `digest` in concurrent environments to prevent overwriting another operator's changes; after updating, apply the SDN configuration via the reload endpoint for changes to take effect.

examples.summary: Add a new CIDR entry to an existing prefix list

tips: After updating a prefix list, run the SDN apply/reload operation (POST /cluster/sdn) to push changes to all cluster nodes; the PUT alone does not activate changes.
Use the `delete` param to remove specific entries by name/key rather than resubmitting the full list.
The `lock-token` param is only needed when the SDN global config is locked by another operation; normal updates do not require it.
Prefix list IDs follow the pve-sdn-prefix-list-id format — typically lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.
